newsitem.title: USA: Nu Skin Asia postpones public offering.
newsitem.headline: Nu Skin Asia postpones public offering.

text.p: Nu Skin Asia Pacific Inc said Monday it postponed its planned public offering of seven million shares of its class A common stock.

"The stockholders who intended to offer shares feel it is imprudent to proceed with the offering in the light of the recent decline of our stock price," said chief executive Steve Lund in a statement.
Nu Skin on June 5 filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission to offer the shares.
In the past month, Nu Skin's stock dropped from more than 27 to close at 24-5/8 Friday, close to its 52-week low of 23.
The marketing company of personal care and nutrition products reported earnings of $20.5 million, or $0.24 a share in the first quarter, compared with $14.8 million, or $0.18 a share the year before.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment.
